rv.q: Overall, it is a lovely show that will be appreciated not only by Sinatra fans, but by all lovers of the Great American Songbook.
It may be their Sinatra but it isn’t mine.
For all lovers of great music this is your show!
Running 90 minutes without intermission, Our Sinatra: a Musical Celebration packs 50 songs from across Sinatra’s career into a brisk, joyful evening.

cn.t: Critics largely embrace this Sinatra tribute's 25th anniversary revival, praising the performers' passion and iconic song selections. One dissenting voice finds it "buoyant if not fully satisfying," but the consensus leans warmly positive.
